findings.body: Raise: Not done. A stopped review can still give the owner a gate label and an incomplete account of a blocker instead of one plain sentence saying what goes wrong for whom. At line 991, `plain()` removes `Not done.` but leaves the common `Not done:` finding title intact, then keeps only the body's first sentence. The branch's recorded review in `.factory/fixes/stop-question-plain.json:28-32` is a concrete example: its title begins `Not done:`, and the sentence explaining the effect on the owner comes after the first sentence. The named close proof uses a `Raise:` title, so it passes without exercising this input.
